Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome projects {#projects}

List, fetch, update, delete and export tenant projects.

```text
apiome projects [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`delete`](#projects-delete), [`export`](#projects-export), [`get`](#projects-get), [`list`](#projects-list), [`update`](#projects-update).

## apiome projects delete {#projects-delete}

Delete a project — permanently, or with --archive restorably (DELETE /v1/projects/{tenant}/{id}).

Shows what will be removed, refuses a project with published versions unless --force is passed (exit 6), and asks you to type the project slug before a permanent delete.

```text
apiome projects delete [OPTIONS] PROJECT_REF
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID (with --yes, the exact slug). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the typed confirmation; the argument must then be the project's exact slug. |
| `--archive` | flag |  |  | Archive (soft-delete, restorable) instead of deleting permanently. |
| `--force` | flag |  |  | Delete (or archive) even though the project has published versions (exit 6 without). |

## apiome projects export {#projects-export}

Export a whole project as one JSON (or YAML) document — versions, classes, paths, tags.

The document format is ``apiome.project-export`` version 1. Summary counts and the document's SHA-256 go to stderr, so stdout carries only the export.

```text
apiome projects export [OPTIONS] PROJECT_REF
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output`, `-o` | path |  |  | Write to this file instead of stdout. |
| `--include` | text |  |  | Sections to export, comma-separated: versions, classes, properties, paths, tags, migrations (default: all of them). |
| `--exclude` | text |  |  | Sections to leave out, comma-separated. |
| `--versions` | text |  |  | Only these versions, by label (e.g. v2.0.0,v2.1.0). |
| `--format` | text | `json` |  | json (streamed) or yaml (built in memory). |
| `--gzip` | flag |  |  | Compress the output with gzip (reproducible bytes). |
| `--deterministic` / `--no-deterministic` | flag | `--deterministic` |  | Sort keys for byte-identical output across runs; --no-deterministic adds exportedAt. |

## apiome projects update {#projects-update}

Update a project's name, slug, description or domain (PUT /v1/projects/{tenant}/{id}).

Only the fields that change are sent. Every update carries the project's ``updated_at`` as a precondition — the dump's for ``--from-file``, otherwise the one read just before the write — so a concurrent edit is never overwritten: the command exits 6 instead.

```text
apiome projects update [OPTIONS] PROJECT_REF
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | text |  |  | New display name. |
| `--rename` | text |  |  | New slug. Asks for confirmation (or --yes): links using the old slug stop working. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | New description; an empty string clears it. |
| `--domain` | text |  |  | Domain category: iot, social, gaming, travel, media, ecommerce, healthcare, finance, saas, education, realestate, logistics, or none. |
| `--from-file` | path |  |  | Apply an edited `projects get --json` dump; fails (exit 6) if the project changed since the dump. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the --rename confirmation. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Print the changes as a diff without sending them. |
